title: Translating Village Dialect for Town Doctors
title_te: పల్లె మాటలను పట్టణ డాక్టర్లకు అర్థమయ్యేలా చెప్పడం
problem: When Amma goes to the hospital in town, she speaks in her deep Telangana rural dialect, and the hospital staff sometimes misunderstand her pain descriptions.
idea: A word helper and pain chart. Gemini turns our village words into clear words for the doctor, and a Canva body chart shows where it hurts. Here you can tap what Amma says.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What is Amma saying?
widgets.intro: Tap Amma's words to see how to tell the doctor clearly. The doctor will decide what it means after checking.
widgets.question: Amma tells the nurse:

options.label: కడుపులో మంట
options.result: Tell the doctor: 'Burning feeling in my stomach.'

options.label: తల తిరుగుతోంది
options.result: Tell the doctor: 'I feel dizzy. My head is spinning.'

options.label: గుండె దడ
options.result: Tell the doctor: 'My heart is beating very fast.'
options.tip: If there is chest pain or breathing trouble, call 108 at once.

options.label: నడుము నొప్పి
options.result: Tell the doctor: 'Pain in my lower back.'

options.label: ఒళ్ళు కాలిపోతోంది
options.result: Tell the doctor: 'I have fever. My body is very hot.'

items.title: Where
items.text: Point to the place on the body chart.

items.title: Since when
items.text: How many days or hours has it been?

items.title: How strong
items.text: Say a number from 1 (little) to 10 (very bad).

items.title: Medicines
items.text: Show all tablets you are already taking.

how: Make a list of words Amma and the elders use for pain and illness.
Ask Gemini to write each word in clear, simple English and standard Telugu.
Check the list with a nurse or ASHA worker to make sure it is correct.
Open Canva and make a front and back body outline with numbered parts.
Add a pain scale from 1 to 10 with happy and sad faces.
Print it, keep it in Amma's hospital file, and use it at the next visit.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student from rural Telangana. Here are some village words my mother uses to describe pain: [list words]. For each, give the clear English meaning and standard Telugu so a town doctor can understand. Don't diagnose any illness.
